extendedTextMessage.text:
In quiet corners where thoughts begin,
the world grows loud, then folds back in.
A single breath, a passing spark,
a thread of light inside the dark.
The day unfolds like paper thin,
with every loss and every win.
We chase the sun, we miss the rain,
and learn to dance with joy and pain.
No map is drawn for where we go,
just shifting winds and rivers’ flow.
Yet even lost, we still become
the beat of hearts, the rising drum.
So take your time, don’t rush the sky—
the stars still know the reason why.
And in your steps, however small,
you carry worlds inside them all.
